description: This file defines the DeflateStream class in the ZipStream namespace, which extends a Stream class to add functionality for deflate compression using stream filters. It manages adding and removing the deflate filter, as well as rewinding the stream with filter adjustments.

classes.name: DeflateStream
classes.description: A class extending Stream to handle deflate compression filters for streaming ZIP data.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream, temporarily removing and then restoring the deflate filter to prepare for a rewind operation.

methods.name: removeDeflateFilter
methods.description: Removes the deflate filter from the stream if it is active.

methods.name: addDeflateFilter
methods.description: Adds a deflate stream filter to the stream, configured with options such as comment, method, deflate level, and time.
